dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: The 'MON' dataset and controls from clinical datasets were used for training (HCtrain) and testing (HCtest). Clinical datasets provided cases. HCP150 was used for the normative diffusion tractography dataset (dysconnectome map).
